title: Fabulous two days touring Barcelona and Montserrat area!!
text: We had a fantastic two days with Pedro as our guide.  We saw all the key Gaudí sites in Barcelona and learned so much from him about the city’s history.   On the 2nd day, Montserrat was beautiful and we were able to choose what activities we wanted to do, including taking the funicular and hiking to the cross.   Pedro had reserved an amazing place for lunch and we thoroughly enjoyed the winery tour on the way back.  Overall a fantastic tour - would highly recommend Pedro and this tour!!
author: Elaine_L

title: Wonderful tour guide! Fred is so friendly and knowledgeable!
text: Wonderful list of activities and sites! We really enjoyed our two day tour of amazing & beautiful Barcelona!
author: Linda_G

title: Great Way to See Barcelona For The First Time
text: Great opportunity to get a personalized tour of the top sites by a knowledgeable local guide.  Pedro,  our guide did an amazing job of flexing the experience to our interests and was full of great historical and cultural knowledge of the region.  We highly recommend!
author: Mike_C

title: Andy is the best in Barcelona
text: The best part was having a spectacular guide like Andy to facilitate and modify our experience based on our desire to see this or that depending on how importance certain sites were to us.  He had to vote to share his knowledge about the history and backstory of all the places we visited. He was very enriching and engaging and very affable and attentive. He was empathetic to my issues that I had personally but was able to still continue to enjoy an experience all we saw
author: DarlaS_M

title: This tour was excellent,...
text: This tour was excellent our tour guide Andy was very knowledgeable and extremely informative and made us feel at ease from the very beginning. We were able to experience an in depth look into the wonderful city of Barcelona,  the time that was allotted for the experience was “just right”. We did not feel rushed at any moment and were able to enjoy every single minute. Highly recommend!
author: Juan_L

title: Wonderful & Knowledgeable Guide
text: My guide, Fred, was very friendly & knowledgeable. He spoke several languages including Catalunya which made entries to places very easy. He chose wonderful places for snacks & lunch. It was a wonderful experience!
author: Allen_P

title: So Good!
text: We learned so much and were treated completely wonderful. The best use of our time over a weekend only trip to Barcelona.
author: Trail12192847367

title: Our guide was very...
text: Our guide was very friendly and knowledgeable. He answered all of our questions and made us feel valued.
author: Michael_L

title: Pedro and Fred are AWESOME
text:
This was a wonderful two day experience for my family! Pedro and Fred were our guides and they were the best. Unbelievable flexibility and working to ensure our family had the most wonderful experience. Despite some limitations on my family's part, they worked with us and WOW.... Awesome. 
This two day tour can't be beat. If you have Pedro or Fred as your guide, your trip will be amazing.
author: Catherine_P

title: A great two days!
text: The Familia Sagrada was incredibly beautiful. Park Güell was great to see too! Montserrat was worth the trip to see the natural beauty. The winery was interesting and fun! We had a great 2 days with our guide Paolo. He was very knowledgeable and kind. I use a scooter for mobility and he made sure I could be included in everything! Thank you!
author: Mitzi_B
